children: Core Scientific received conditional ERCOT approvals for electrical power allocations across its Texas data centers, clarifying existing and planned capacity status.
Denton: 297 MW deemed Base Load Pathway (a) as energized before Mar 25, 2022 and excluded from Batch Zero; additional 74 MW validated in ERCOT 2025 RTP.
Pecos: Existing 300 MW approved in Batch Zero as Base Load Pathway (b); additional 300 MW approved as Studied Load; final allocation awaits Batch Zero conclusion.
Hunt: Planned 431 MW conditionally approved in Batch Zero as Pathway (e); interconnection studies passed, stability study approved, collateral posted, equipment ordered and construction started.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Core Scientific wins conditional ERCOT power approvals for Texas data centers
